description: This PHP source file defines the 'Arn' class within the AWS SDK, responsible for parsing, validating, and representing Amazon Resource Names (ARNs). It includes methods for parsing ARN strings, converting to string, retrieving components, and validating ARN structure.

classes.name: Arn
classes.description: Represents and processes AWS Resource Names (ARNs), providing parsing, validation, and component access.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an ARN string into its components.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an Arn object from an array or string, validating the data.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the ARN.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the ARN components as an array.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the structure of ARN components.

methods.name: isValidHostLabel
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid host label for ARN components.
